purpose: Hand-written demonstration records for the scored prompts.
note: Every field here is invented. No value is taken from the corpus, from the injected set or from the natural set, so that no item can be answered by recalling an exemplar. The prompt template that surrounds these records is settled in Phase 5 and is versioned beside them; this file holds the records and their labels only.

exemplars.label: clean
exemplars.reason: Every value is well formed and consistent with the position.
